scene.topic_description:
Situation: On the gym floor, the learner speaks with a trainer during a workout in a new country. The learner wants to train safely, explain personal goals and experience, and understand instructions on technique and intensity.
Learner: the learner's role. Partner: the trainer.
Learner must be able to: explain training goals such as strength, weight loss, or general fitness; describe previous gym experience and current fitness level; ask how to use a machine or do an exercise correctly; understand corrections, repetitions, rest time, and how heavy the weight should be.
Partner will: ask about goals, experience, and any physical limitations; explain how to position the body and use equipment; correct mistakes and give instructions about sets, reps, and pace.
Not in this scene: membership prices, payment, opening hours, locker access, buying sports products.
scene.image_prompt: realistic photo of a gym trainer showing an exercise beside a weight machine on the training floor, bright indoor light, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up
